## ♿ Accessibility Issue Report

### 👤 User Profile
- **User Type**: [Visually impaired/Hearing impaired/Motor impaired/Cognitive impaired/Elderly/Other]
- **Assistive Technology**: [Screen reader/Voice control/Switch device/Keyboard only/Touch only/Other]
- **Platform**: [Web/Windows/Android/iOS]
- **Device**: [Device specifications]
- **Browser**: [Chrome/Firefox/Safari/Edge/Other]

### 🎯 Accessibility Issue
What specific accessibility problem are you experiencing?

#### Visual Accessibility
- [ ] **Low Contrast** - Text/UI elements have insufficient contrast
- [ ] **Small Text** - Text is too small to read
- [ ] **Color Blindness** - Color-only information is problematic
- [ ] **Screen Reader Issues** - Screen reader doesn't work properly
- [ ] **Focus Indicators** - No clear focus indicators
- [ ] **Text Scaling** - Text doesn't scale properly
- [ ] **High Contrast Mode** - Issues with high contrast mode
- [ ] **Dark Mode** - Problems with dark mode

#### Hearing Accessibility
- [ ] **No Visual Cues** - Audio-only information without visual alternatives
- [ ] **Volume Control** - Insufficient volume controls
- [ ] **Subtitle Issues** - Missing or poor subtitles
- [ ] **Visual Alerts** - Missing visual notifications
- [ ] **Audio Descriptions** - Missing audio descriptions
- [ ] **Sound Indicators** - No visual alternatives to sound

#### Motor Accessibility
- [ ] **Small Touch Targets** - Touch targets are too small
- [ ] **Keyboard Navigation** - Poor keyboard navigation
- [ ] **Gesture Issues** - Complex or difficult gestures
- [ ] **Timing Issues** - Time limits are too short
- [ ] **Fine Motor Control** - Requires precise movements
- [ ] **Switch Device Support** - Poor switch device support
- [ ] **Voice Control** - Voice commands don't work properly

#### Cognitive Accessibility
- [ ] **Complex Interface** - UI is too complex or confusing
- [ ] **Information Overload** - Too much information at once
- [ ] **Inconsistent Navigation** - Navigation is inconsistent
- [ ] **Poor Instructions** - Instructions are unclear
- [ ] **Memory Requirements** - Requires too much memorization
- [ ] **Distraction Issues** - Too many distractions
- [ ] **Language Complexity** - Text is too complex

### 🔍 WCAG Compliance
Which WCAG guidelines are affected?

#### Perceivable
- [ ] **1.1.1 Non-text Content** - Images without alt text
- [ ] **1.2.1 Audio-only and Video-only** - No alternatives
- [ ] **1.3.1 Info and Relationships** - Poor semantic structure
- [ ] **1.4.1 Use of Color** - Color-only information
- [ ] **1.4.3 Contrast** - Insufficient contrast ratios
- [ ] **1.4.4 Resize text** - Text doesn't resize
- [ ] **1.4.5 Images of Text** - Text images instead of real text

#### Operable
- [ ] **2.1.1 Keyboard** - No keyboard access
- [ ] **2.2.1 Timing Adjustable** - No time limit adjustment
- [ ] **2.3.1 Three Flashes** - Seizure risk
- [ ] **2.4.1 Bypass Blocks** - No skip links
- [ ] **2.4.2 Page Titled** - Missing page titles
- [ ] **2.4.3 Focus Order** - Poor focus order
- [ ] **2.4.4 Link Purpose** - Unclear link purposes

#### Understandable
- [ ] **3.1.1 Language of Page** - No language identification
- [ ] **3.2.1 On Focus** - Unexpected focus changes
- [ ] **3.2.2 On Input** - Unexpected input behavior
- [ ] **3.3.1 Error Identification** - Errors not identified
- [ ] **3.3.2 Labels or Instructions** - Missing instructions

#### Robust
- [ ] **4.1.1 Parsing** - Invalid HTML/markup
- [ ] **4.1.2 Name, Role, Value** - Missing accessibility attributes

### 📊 Impact Assessment
How does this accessibility issue affect users?

#### User Impact
- [ ] **Complete Blocker** - Prevents use of the application
- [ ] **Major Issue** - Significantly impacts usability
- [ ] **Moderate Issue** - Causes difficulty but usable
- [ ] **Minor Issue** - Slight inconvenience
- [ ] **Cosmetic Issue** - Minor accessibility improvement

#### Legal/Compliance Impact
- [ ] **WCAG Compliance** - Violates WCAG guidelines
- [ ] **Legal Requirements** - May violate accessibility laws
- [ ] **App Store Requirements** - May violate store policies
- [ ] **Organizational Policy** - Violates internal policies

### 🛠️ Suggested Solutions
What solutions would improve accessibility?

#### Immediate Fixes
- [ ] **Add Alt Text** - Add descriptive alt text to images
- [ ] **Improve Contrast** - Increase color contrast ratios
- [ ] **Add Focus Indicators** - Make focus visible
- [ ] **Add Keyboard Navigation** - Enable keyboard access
- [ ] **Add ARIA Labels** - Add proper ARIA attributes

#### Long-term Improvements
- [ ] **Redesign UI** - Redesign for better accessibility
- [ ] **Add Accessibility Mode** - Special accessibility settings
- [ ] **Implement Screen Reader Support** - Full screen reader compatibility
- [ ] **Add Voice Control** - Voice command support
- [ ] **Add Switch Support** - Switch device support

### 📋 Testing Requirements
What testing should be performed to verify accessibility improvements?

#### Automated Testing
- [ ] **Accessibility Audit** - Automated accessibility testing
- [ ] **Contrast Testing** - Automated contrast checking
- [ ] **Screen Reader Testing** - Automated screen reader testing
- [ ] **Keyboard Testing** - Automated keyboard navigation testing

#### Manual Testing
- [ ] **User Testing** - Test with actual users with disabilities
- [ ] **Expert Review** - Accessibility expert review
- [ ] **Assistive Technology Testing** - Test with various assistive technologies
- [ ] **Cross-Platform Testing** - Test on all platforms

### 🎯 Acceptance Criteria
What defines successful resolution of this accessibility issue?

#### Technical Requirements
- [ ] **WCAG Compliance** - Meets WCAG 2.1 AA standards
- [ ] **Screen Reader Support** - Works with major screen readers
- [ ] **Keyboard Navigation** - Fully keyboard accessible
- [ ] **Color Contrast** - Meets contrast ratio requirements
- [ ] **Focus Management** - Proper focus handling

#### User Requirements
- [ ] **User Testing** - Passes user testing with disabilities
- [ ] **Expert Approval** - Approved by accessibility experts
- [ ] **Real-world Usage** - Works in real-world scenarios
- [ ] **Documentation** - Accessibility features documented
